title: Get the length of the student dictionary
description:
Get the length of the student dictionary.

Python-Gym adaptation: implement as `dict_length(student)`, returning the number of keys in the given student dictionary.
hints: You need a single number: how many key-value pairs the dictionary holds.
The same built-in function you'd use to count the items in a list or the characters in a string also works directly on a dictionary.
Pass the dictionary to the built-in `len()` function and return the result.
expected_behavior: Returns an integer equal to the number of keys in the given dictionary.
explanation: The built-in len() function works on dictionaries just as it does on lists and strings, counting the number of key-value pairs stored in it.
